card.name: The letters UA ending a term
card.fires_on: The letters UA (or ua) as a separate piece at the end of a name or abbreviation, such as the brand names EXXUA and WAINUA, unstable angina (UA), serum uric acid (sUA), or the University of Arizona (UA).

modes.label: Brand name ending
modes.description: UA closes an invented drug brand name such as EXXUA or WAINUA.

modes.label: Medical abbreviation
modes.description: UA stands for unstable angina or serum uric acid in clinical text.
modes.example: was not administered until coronary anatomy was established in<< UA>>/NSTEMI patients and in STEMI

modes.label: Other UA uses
modes.description: UA is the University of Arizona abbreviation or the end of a place or plant name like Dakua.
modes.example: Michael Drake of the<< UA>> Lunar and Planetary Laboratory, principal investigator

card.plain: It fires on the letters UA when they finish a drug brand name or serve as an abbreviation.
